reviews.text: Pretty refreshing. I dont see a difference yet but it does feel hydrating after using it. It is my first eye patch too so I cant compare with the others brand. But as for now,it is good enough.
reviews.zh: 幾清爽。我暫時未見到分別，但用完之後感覺幾滋潤。呢個係我第一次用眼膜，所以冇其他品牌可以比較。但係而家嚟講，已經夠好。

reviews.text: I’ve been trying the Mixsoon Hydrogel Eye Patches, and they’ve quickly become one of my favorite under-eye treatments. The patches have a refreshing gel texture that feels cooling as soon as you apply them, which helps reduce puffiness and makes the eyes look more awake.
reviews.zh: 我一直都試緊 Mixsoon Hydrogel Eye Patches，佢哋好快就成為我最愛嘅眼部護理之一。眼膜有清新嘅啫喱質地，一貼上就有涼涼嘅感覺，有助減輕浮腫，令眼睛睇落更有精神。

reviews.text: Es uno de los productos que más recomiendo soy de piel mixta y deja una textura tipo porcelana precioso me encanta no es para nasa pesado se siente muy bien en la piel sin duda lo seguiré comprando deja superar hidratado el área de los ojos no irrita para nada
reviews.zh: 呢款係我最推薦嘅產品之一。我係混合皮，佢令皮膚留低一種好似瓷器咁嘅質感，好靚。佢完全唔覺得重，塗喺皮膚上感覺好好。我一定會繼續買。佢令眼部區域好滋潤，完全唔會刺激。

reviews.text: I’ve been using these for over a week but haven’t noticed much of a difference. One thing to note is that the gel tends to slip off easily, so I often have to readjust it, which can be a bit inconvenient.
reviews.zh: 我用咗超過一個禮拜，但係未見到太大分別。要留意嘅係，啫喱好易滑走，所以我經常要重新調整位置，有啲唔方便。

reviews.text: I like them I don’t know about the long term effect yet, just started using them. They are like jelly eye patches, they stick really good without slipping.
reviews.zh: 我鍾意佢哋，但係長期效果我仲唔知道，因為我啱啱開始用。佢哋好似果凍眼膜咁，貼得好實，唔會滑。

reviews.text:
I’ve used these patch every other day at morning and my eyes feels hydrated and as result my wrinkles looks less.
Adhesion is great! Did not slip and stays under my eyes. I can continue doing other activities.
reviews.zh:
我隔日早上用呢款眼膜，眼睛感覺水潤，因此皺紋睇落少咗。
貼服度好好！冇滑走，可以留喺眼下。我可以繼續做其他活動。

reviews.text: I like the mixsoon bean line itself because it’s moisturizing but I feel like there not enough essence at all to really make a difference.
reviews.zh: 我鍾意 mixsoon bean 系列本身，因為佢好保濕，但係我覺得精華液完全唔夠，所以冇真正嘅效果分別。

reviews.text: Love that it adheres very well and does not fall off ehen you move around, also hydrates and plumps your eye area.. great for before applying makeup
reviews.zh: 好鍾意佢貼得好實，就算郁嚟郁去都唔會跌落嚟，仲可以令眼部區域水潤飽滿。好啱用喺化妝前。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
